strings.app.restart.title: Restart required
strings.app.restart.message:
Some settings take effect only after KTile restarts.

After a restart:
  · global hotkeys are registered with the new settings
  · the tray menu is rebuilt with the new settings

Your settings have been saved; you can keep using KTile.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.language.hint: Saved immediately; the settings window itself switches the next time you open it.
strings.settings.gridHintRearrange: Note: the grid is smaller than the current layout, so some tiles will be rearranged.
strings.settings.gridHintRange: Grid range 3 - 16. The window resizes to fit.
strings.settings.followLaunch.pickTitle: Select a program to launch with KTile
strings.settings.followLaunch.full: You can add up to {0} programs.
strings.settings.followLaunch.tip: These programs start together with KTile; anything already running is skipped. You can also tick "Launch at startup with KTile" in a tile's context menu — such entries use that tile's arguments, start-in folder and administrator setting, follow later edits to it, and keep working with the saved settings if the tile is deleted. Targets may be relative to the folder containing KTile.exe, e.g. tools\app.exe.
strings.settings.winKeyNote: Ctrl+Win still opens the Start menu while Win-tap is enabled.
strings.settings.plugins.intro: One subfolder per plugin, each containing a plugin.json.
strings.settings.plugins.col.name: Name
strings.settings.plugins.footnote:
Install: pick a plugin.json — the whole folder is copied in.
Remove: icons and scripts go with it, and this cannot be undone.
Visible refresh: visibleRefreshSeconds from the manifest — the panel refreshes at that rate while shown; 0 means only when opened.
strings.settings.plugins.selectFirst: Select a plugin in the list first.
strings.settings.plugins.removeConfirm:
Remove the plugin "{0}"?

strings.settings.radial.tip.enable: Press the trigger button and drag beyond the drag threshold to open the wheel. A plain click is not a gesture and the original button event is replayed.
strings.settings.radial.tip.triggerKey: Press and drag this button to open the wheel.
strings.settings.radial.tip.modifier:
With a modifier (Ctrl / Shift / Alt) the wheel opens only when the modifier and the trigger button are pressed together; dragging the trigger button alone is passed through to gesture tools such as MouseInc.
None: KTile takes the trigger button exclusively — a plain click still replays the original button, but dragging no longer reaches gesture tools.
The suppress key is only available when the modifier is None: with a modifier, not pressing the modifier already means no wheel, so an extra rule would ask the same key to be pressed and not pressed at once.
strings.settings.radial.tip.dragThreshold: How far the pointer must move after pressing to count as a gesture. Too small and hand jitter fires it by accident — mouse habits vary, so 15–20 px is a safe range; too large and the wheel takes forever to show up.
strings.settings.radial.tip.cancelRadius: Release beyond this radius to cancel without running any action. Must be larger than the drag threshold.
strings.settings.radial.tip.suppress:
While any of these keys is held the wheel stays closed and mouse events pass through untouched. Tick several in a row; click outside the list to close it.
Only available when the modifier is None.
strings.settings.radial.tip.summary:
Sector actions and the process blacklist are edited in "Edit sector actions".
Per-application wheels come from the slugin folder and are not set here.
strings.settings.radialPlugins.intro: One subfolder per application, each with a radial.json and its own icons.
strings.settings.radialPlugins.col.name: Name
strings.settings.radialPlugins.footnote:
"Open JSON" edits the manifest in the default editor; "Rescan" applies it.
Matching compares process names only; ties go to the higher priority.
Icons live in the plugin folder; SVGs use a 24×24 canvas.

strings.radialedit.title: Radial menu settings
strings.radialedit.col.name: Name
strings.radialedit.keyHint: For example C / F4 / Space; only used by shortcut actions.
strings.radialedit.blacklistColumn: Process name (no wheel in these apps)
strings.radialedit.blacklistHint:
Matches the whole process name, case-insensitive (for example chrome.exe); wildcards are not supported.
On a match, mouse events pass through completely: context menus and gesture tools keep working in that app.
A few UWP apps all run as ApplicationFrameHost.exe — blacklisting it affects every UWP app.

strings.radialedit.hint.emptySector: This sector is empty; dragging here runs nothing.
strings.radialedit.hint.shortcut: Shortcut actions need no target: pick a modifier and a key; they are injected into the foreground window (e.g. Copy = Ctrl + C).
strings.radialedit.hint.builtin: Built-in command: click "Choose…" to pick from the system item list instead of typing an id.
strings.radialedit.hint.url: URL actions are opened with the default browser.
strings.radialedit.hint.file: "Choose…" picks a file or folder; you can also paste a path.
